profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Speed and sharp pursuit defined the historical wire-haired Whippet. Beauty, a red bitch described by Freeman Lloyd, used her nose and anticipated where rabbits would emerge from banks and hedges. In California, the rough-coated Kerryline won 58 of 60 races; her keeper’s family maintained the rough line through another bitch, Happy Sally.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Historical rough-coated Whippets paired racing speed with pursuit; Beauty used scent, while Kerryline excelled on the track.
